info Section editing — coming soon

Lyria's current API generates a full clip per call — there's no API to "edit only seconds 0:10–0:30". Workarounds today:

  • Regenerate with a sharper prompt (the same builder, with custom notes like "starts soft and builds at 0:15").
  • Edit the MP3 in your DAW (Audacity, GarageBand, Descript) — our downloads are 192 kbps stereo, lossless to splice.

schedule On our roadmap: in-browser splicing of multiple Lyria generations into a single track via the Web Audio API.
